profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google | ex-GitHub
profile.summary:
I’m a Staff Software Engineer at Google, working in the Cloud AI Developer Tools organization.

Previously, I spent 6.5 years at GitHub, where I worked across Codespaces, Copilot, and agentic developer platforms. Most recently, I focused on the infrastructure behind AI-native developer experiences, including agent runtimes, orchestration, identity, extensibility, and multi-agent systems.

I’m particularly interested in agentic software development, AI infrastructure, developer tooling, and the evolving ways humans and AI build software together.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical lead for GitHub's Agent Platform, evolving GitHub's cloud coding agent into an extensible platform powering GitHub AI experiences, Custom Agents, and third-party AI integrations.
- Architected GitHub's extensible agent runtime enabling first-party GitHub agents, Claude, Codex, and future partner agents to execute natively on GitHub. 
- Led the design and rollout of GitHub's production cloud-agent runtime migration to the Copilot SDK, rebuilding the runtime that powers GitHub's cloud coding experiences while preserving full product behavior through a zero-regression migration.
- Designed core platform primitives for agent orchestration, identity propagation, session lifecycle, permissions, MCP integration, telemetry, and runtime execution. 
- Delivered foundational platform capabilities for GitHub Custom Agents and extensible third-party AI integrations, partnering closely with Product, OpenAI, Anthropic, and internal platform teams. 
- Authored architecture proposals and drove cross-team technical direction for GitHub's AI platform.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Member of the founding engineering team that built GitHub Codespaces from 0→1, delivering core platform capabilities for cloud development. 
- Designed and implemented native SSH support for GitHub Codespaces, leading the project end-to-end and open sourcing the implementation in collaboration with GitHub and Go community maintainers. 
- Built distributed backend infrastructure for GitHub Feeds/Conduit, developing scalable ingestion abstractions and production services supporting developer workflows.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical leader for collaboration and version-control infrastructure supporting large-scale design workflows. 
- Designed and implemented a high-performance lexer/parser for proprietary Adobe file formats (Illustrator, Photoshop, etc.), enabling Abstract to expand beyond Sketch into the broader Adobe ecosystem. 
- Delivered the technical foundation for a major product expansion that increased the company's addressable market while maintaining performant parsing of complex binary formats.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led engineering for a SaaS location-intelligence platform helping retailers understand customer movement, demographics, and purchasing behavior. 
- Architected the platform powering geospatial analytics and audience segmentation used to drive location-aware advertising campaigns. 
- Led engineering across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and product while scaling the platform from concept to production.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Architected and developed a modern React-based learning platform powering thousands of instructors and students. 
- Led the migration to a component-based frontend architecture during the early adoption of React and ES6. 
Built high-performance client applications supporting interactive scheduling, lessons, and online learning workflows.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the core engineering for a large-scale video streaming platform serving the LATAM market. 
Built high-performance client applications delivering on-demand media experiences comparable to modern streaming platforms. 
- Designed frontend architecture optimized for responsive playback, reliability, and scalability.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Kaufman Rossin Fund Services I led the front end engineering team in the development of a hedge fund administration system with technologies like HTML5, AngularJS, ReactJS, and Java.

As the lead front engineer I implemented a testing framework with Node and WebDriver which allowed to perform E2E (or UAT) tests on a hybrid application (SPA/Server Side). Similar to AngularJS' Protractor.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I led the implementation of new features and enhancements at oaSES, and share the vision of developing a highly capable software solution for all tutoring providers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked with the Trellis Desk team and also developed internal applications used by the company. Specialized using the LAMP stack with rich front end functionality.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: PHP / MySQL / HTML developer doing Backend/Frontend development for client websites and web applications.
